Notes:
1. These standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended on 30 September 2026 have been reviewed and 
recommended for approval by the Audit, Risk Management and Ethics Committee and accordingly approved by the Board of Directors of Varun 
Beverages Limited (“VBL” or “the Company”) at their respective meetings held on 30 October 2026. The Statutory Auditors have conducted a 
limited review of these financial results.
2. These financial results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles of applicable Indian Accounting 
Standards ('Ind AS’) notified under the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 as specified in section 133 of the Companies Act, 
2013 (read with SEBI Circular CIR/CFD/FAC/62/2016 dated 05 July 2016 and other recognised accounting practices and policies).
3. VBL follows calendar year as its financial year as approved by the Company Law Board, New Delhi.
4. The business activities of the Company and its subsidiaries (together referred to as the "Group") predominantly fall within a single primary 
business segment viz. manufacturing and sale of beverages. There is no separate reportable business segment. The Group operates in two 
principal geographical areas, i.e., in India, its home country, and in other countries. The aforesaid is in line with review of operating results by the 
chief operating decision maker. The sate of products of the Group is seasonal.
5. During the quarter ended 30 September 2026, Varun Beverages (Zimbabwe) (Private) Limited, subsidiary of our Company has incorporated a 
subsidiary company in Zimbabwe namely “Varun Beverages Holding (Zimbabwe) (Private) Limited” as a vehicle to hold investments.
6. During the quarter ended 30 September 2026, the Company incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary in India, KIVA Spirits and Company 
Limited, to carry on the business of Ready-to-Drink (RTD), alcoholic beverages and allied products.
7. During the quarter ended 30 September 2026, Varun Beverages (Zimbabwe) (Private) Limited (a subsidiary of our Company) on 24 
September 2026 has entered into an Exclusive Distribution Agreement with Mondelez South Africa Proprietary Limited (“Mondelez”) effective 
from 01 October 2026 for the exclusive distribution of chocolate, biscuit, candy and gum products of Mondelez in the territory of the Republic of 
Zimbabwe.
8. During the nine months period ended 30 September 2026, The Beverage Company Proprietary Limited (“Bevco”), a subsidiary of the 
Company, entered into an agreement dated 17 March 2026 to acquire a 100% equity stake in Crickley Dairy Proprietary Limited (“Crickley”) at an 
enterprise value of ZAR 238 million (equivalent to T 1,314.68 million, at an exchange rate of ZAR 1 = 5.52), a company incorporated in South 
Africa, from Clark Holdings Proprietary Limited (“Seller”), with the objective of diversifying its product portfolio into new categories, including value 
added dairy-based beverages.
However, due to non-fulfillment of certain condition precedent the transaction is not consumated and during the quarter ended 30 September 
2026, the above-mentioned transaction has been referred by sellers to The Arbitration Foundation of Southern Africa (“AFSA”).
9. During the nine months period ended 30 September 2026, The Beverage Company Proprietary Limited (“Bevco”), subsidiary of our Company 
in South Africa, has acquired 100% Share Capital of Twizza Proprietary Limited ("Twizza"), a company incorporated under the laws of South 
Africa, at an enterprise value of ZAR 2,053 Million (T 11,398 Million; 1 ZAR = 5.55), accordingly it has become step down subsidiary of our 
Company w.e.f. 18 March 2026. The Company is in the process of determining the fair values of acquired assets and liabilities including goodwill 
as per the requirement of Ind AS 103 "Business Combinations". Accordingly, the consolidation of Twizza has been done on provisional basis 
from the date of acquisition. Twizza is inter-alia engaged in the business of manufacturing and distribution of own branded non-alcoholic 
Beverages.
During the quarter ended 30 September 2026, on 02 July 2026, the Board of Directors of Bevco and Twizza have approved the merger of Twizza 
with its holding company i.e. Bevco, w.e.f. 01 August 2026. Post merger, the shareholding remained unchanged since merger is between a 
subsidiary and its step-down subsidiary of the Company and consequently, Twizza has ceased to be a step-down subsidiary of the Company.

principles generally accepted in India and is in compliance with the presentation and disclosure requirements of 
Regulation 33 of the Listing Regulations. Our responsibility is to express a conclusion on the Statement based on

3. We conducted our review of the Statement in accordance with the Standard on Review Engagements (SRE) 
2410 - “Review of Interim Financial Information Performed by the Independent Auditor of the Entity”, issued by the 
Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. This standard requires that we plan and perform the review to obtain 
moderate assurance as to whether the Statements are free of material misstatement. A review of interim financial 
information consists of making inquiries, primarily of persons responsible for financial and accounting matters, and 
applying analytical and other review procedures. A review is substantially less in scope than an audit conducted 
in accordance with the Standards on Auditing specified under section 143(10) of the Act, and consequently, does 
not enable us to obtain assurance that we would become aware of all significant matters that might be identified 
in an audit. Accordingly, we do not express an audit opinion.

2019 issued by the SEBI under Regulation 33 (8) of the Listing Regulation, to the extent applicable.
